feedback.issue: Undefined function sanitize_docker_var() called but not defined. Code will fail at runtime when Docker mode is enabled with 'command not found' error.
feedback.impact: Docker spawning completely broken - all Docker mode agent spawns will fail
feedback.evidence: Lines 611, 615, 619 call sanitize_docker_var() but only sanitize_input() is defined at line 67
feedback.suggestion: Replace sanitize_docker_var() calls with sanitize_input() which already exists and handles alphanumeric validation. Alternatively, define sanitize_docker_var() function with Docker-specific validation (image names: alphanumeric + colon + dash + slash + dot; memory: digits + unit suffix)

feedback.issue: CFN_DOCKER_MODE variable used without default value in string comparison. Will cause 'unbound variable' error if strict mode enabled and variable unset.
feedback.impact: Script crashes when CFN_DOCKER_MODE is unset (most common case for automatic detection)
feedback.suggestion: Add default empty string: [[ "${CFN_DOCKER_MODE:-}" == "true" ]] to prevent unbound variable errors. This pattern is already used correctly in old code (line 585 before fix) but was removed in the fix.

feedback.issue: Test suite uses logic simulation instead of actual orchestrate.sh execution. Does not validate real runtime behavior or catch undefined function bugs.
feedback.impact: False confidence - tests pass but actual code fails in production
feedback.evidence: Lines 48-64 duplicate mode selection logic instead of sourcing orchestrate.sh functions
feedback.suggestion: Add integration test that sources orchestrate.sh and calls real spawn_agent() logic with Docker mode enabled. This would catch the sanitize_docker_var() undefined function bug.

feedback.issue: Comments describe priority order but code uses if-elif chain which makes priority implicit rather than explicit
feedback.impact: Low - code works but maintainability could be improved
feedback.evidence: Priority comment says '1, 2, 3' but code structure doesn't make priority obvious
feedback.suggestion: Add inline comments for each branch: '# Priority 1: Explicit true override', '# Priority 2: Explicit false override', '# Priority 3: Automatic detection', '# Priority 4: Default fallback'

feedback.issue: Documentation shows confidence score 0.92 but doesn't account for undefined function bug that breaks Docker mode entirely
feedback.evidence: Confidence 0.92 with rationale 'Fix implementation complete and validated' but sanitize_docker_var() is undefined
feedback.suggestion: Update confidence score to reflect actual validation status. E2E validation is not just 'pending' but critical since unit tests don't catch runtime bugs.

summary.recommendation: ITERATE - Fix undefined function bug before merging

rationale: Fix addresses the root cause correctly (priority-based mode selection) and test coverage validates all 6 mode paths. However, CRITICAL bug (undefined sanitize_docker_var function) makes Docker mode completely non-functional. Fix cannot be merged in current state. Score reflects: +0.30 for correct logic design, +0.15 for comprehensive test matrix, -0.00 for critical runtime bug that breaks primary use case.
